name: @deltaxy.ai/eve-sbx-provider
description: An Eve sandbox provider backed by local Docker Sandboxes microVMs

scripts.test:ownership:live: npm run build && node --input-type=module -e "process.env.SBX10_LIVE='1'; await import('./tests/lifecycle/live.mjs')"
scripts.test:apps:live: npm run build && node --input-type=module -e "process.env.SBX10_APPS_LIVE='1'; await import('./tests/apps/live.mjs')"
scripts.test:sbx10:live: npm run test:ownership:live && npm run test:apps:live
scripts.test:security:live: npm run build && node --input-type=module -e "process.env.SBX11_LIVE='1'; await import('./tests/security/live.mjs')"
scripts.test:subagents:live: npm run build && node --input-type=module -e "process.env.SBX12_LIVE='1'; await import('./tests/subagents/live.mjs')"
